321: ਨਾਨਕ. ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਕੀਤਾ; ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ॥੨॥
O Nanak, who by the perfect Guru's grace has made the Lord's Name his wealth. ॥2॥
ਧੋਹੁ. ਨ ਚਲੀ ਖਸਮ ਨਾਲਿ; ਲਬਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਗੁਤੇ ॥
Deceit does not succeed with the Master; those caught in greed and attachment are ruined.
ਕਰਤਬ ਕਰਨਿ ਭਲੇਰਿਆ; ਮਦਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਸੁਤੇ ॥
Asleep in the intoxication of Maya, they do evil deeds,
ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੂਨਿ ਭਵਾਈਅਨਿ; ਜਮ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਮੁਤੇ ॥
they are pushed through births again and again and left ownerless on Death's road,
ਕੀਤਾ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਆਪਣਾ; ਦੁਖ ਸੇਤੀ ਜੁਤੇ ॥
they reap the fruit of what they have done and are yoked to suffering.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਇ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਐ; ਸਭ ਮੰਦੀ ਰੁਤੇ ॥੧੨॥
O Nanak, if the Lord's Name is forgotten, know every season to be a bad one. ॥12॥
Rising, sitting or sleeping, the same peace stays at all times.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮਿ ਸਲਾਹਿਐ; ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, if we keep praising the Name, mind and body stay cool. ॥1॥
ਲਾਲਚਿ ਅਟਿਆ. ਨਿਤ ਫਿਰੈ; ਸੁਆਰਥੁ. ਕਰੇ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
Smeared with greed, the world wanders constantly; no one does the work of his own real good.
ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ; ਤਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
But, O Nanak, in the mind of one who meets the Guru, that Lord comes to dwell. ॥2॥
ਸਭੇ ਵਸਤੂ ਕਉੜੀਆ; ਸਚੇ ਨਾਉ ਮਿਠਾ ॥
All other things turn bitter in the end; the true Lord's Name alone stays sweet,
ਸਾਦੁ ਆਇਆ. ਤਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਜਨਾਂ; ਚਖਿ ਸਾਧੀ ਡਿਠਾ ॥
but that taste comes to the holy, the Lord's servants, who have tried it and seen,
ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ; ਮਨਿ ਤਿਸੈ ਵੁਠਾ ॥
and it settles in the mind of that one alone in whose destiny the Supreme Lord has written it.
ਇਕੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ; ਭਾਉ ਦੁਯਾ ਕੁਠਾ ॥
Such a one sees the one Lord, untouched by Maya, everywhere; his love of another is destroyed.
ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਜੋੜਿ ਕਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ; ਦੇਵੈ ਤੁਠਾ ॥੧੩॥
Nanak too begs this of the Lord with joined hands, but God gives it to the one with whom He is pleased. ॥13॥
ਜਾਚੜੀ ਸਾ ਸਾਰੁ; ਜੋ ਜਾਚੰਦੀ ਹੇਕੜੋ ॥
That plea is the best which asks for the One Lord.
ਗਾਲੑੀ ਬਿਆ ਵਿਕਾਰ; ਨਾਨਕ ਧਣੀ ਵਿਹੂਣੀਆ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, all other talk, apart from the Master, is useless. ॥1॥
ਨੀਹਿ ਜਿ ਵਿਧਾ ਮੰਨੁ; ਪਛਾਣੂ. ਵਿਰਲੋ ਥਿਓ ॥
Rare is the one who knows God, whose mind is pierced with His love.
O Nanak, such a saint is able to join others to God and shows the straight path. ॥2॥
O my soul, remember that Lord who is the giver and the forgiver.
ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਸਭਿ ਬਿਨਾਸੁ ਹੋਨਿ; ਸਿਮਰਤ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ॥
By remembering the Lord all sins are destroyed.
ਹਰਿ ਮਾਰਗੁ. ਸਾਧੂ ਦਸਿਆ; ਜਪੀਐ ਗੁਰਮੰਤੁ ॥
The Guru has shown the way to the Lord; keep the Guru's teaching always in mind.
ਮਾਇਆ ਸੁਆਦ ਸਭਿ ਫਿਕਿਆ; ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੰਦੁ ॥
Then all the tastes of Maya seem bland and the Lord becomes dear to the mind.
ਧਿਆਇ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੈ; ਜਿਨਿ ਦਿਤੀ ਜਿੰਦੁ ॥੧੪॥
O Nanak, remember the Lord who gave this life. ॥14॥
ਵਤ ਲਗੀ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ; ਜੋ ਬੀਜੇ ਸੋ ਖਾਇ ॥
This is the fitting season to sow the true Lord's Name; whoever sows it eats its fruit.
ਤਿਸਹਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਨਾਨਕਾ; ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਆਇ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, it comes only to the one in whose destiny it is written. ॥1॥
ਮੰਗਣਾ ਤ ਸਚੁ ਇਕੁ; ਜਿਸੁ ਤੁਸਿ ਦੇਵੈ ਆਪਿ ॥
If you must ask, ask only for the Lord's Name; it comes to the one to whom He Himself, being pleased, gives it.
ਜਿਤੁ ਖਾਧੈ. ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੀਐ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਾਹਿਬ ਦਾਤਿ ॥੨॥
When it is eaten the mind is sated; but, O Nanak, it is purely the Master's gift. ॥2॥
ਲਾਹਾ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਸੇ ਖਟਹਿ; ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
Those alone earn profit in the world who have the Lord's Name as their wealth and capital.
ਦੁਤੀਆ ਭਾਉ. ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ; ਸਚੇ ਦੀ ਆਸ ॥
They do not know attachment to any other; their hope is in the One Lord alone.
ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਏਕੁ ਸਰੇਵਿਆ; ਹੋਰੁ ਸਭ ਵਿਣਾਸੁ ॥
They have remembered only the everlasting Lord, for all else appears to them as perishable.
ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਵਿਸਰੈ; ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਸਾਸੁ ॥
Every breath of one who forgets the Supreme Lord goes to waste.
ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ ਜਨ ਰਖਿਆ; ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਸੁ ॥੧੫॥
The Lord has saved His servants by holding them to His breast; O Nanak, I am a sacrifice to Him. ॥15॥
ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਆ; ਮੀਹੁ ਵੁਠਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
When the Supreme Lord gave the command, the rain of the Name began to fall of itself,
ਅੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਉਪਜਿਆ; ਪ੍ਰਿਥਮੀ ਰਜੀ ਤਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਇ ॥
the grain of His praise grows in plenty, and the earth of the heart is fully content.
ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਉਚਰੈ; ਦੁਖੁ ਦਾਲਦੁ ਗਇਆ ਬਿਲਾਇ ॥
That person sings the Lord's virtues for ever, and his pain and poverty depart.
ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਾਇਆ; ਮਿਲਿਆ ਤਿਸੈ ਰਜਾਇ ॥
But this grain is obtained according to what was written before, and it comes by the Lord's will.
It is the Lord who gives life to one dead in Maya; O Nanak, remember Him. ॥1॥
322: If we remember the One Lord, who is free of desire, the state of real life is attained,
ਦੂਜੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਾਇ; ਕਿਨਿ ਬਿਧਿ ਧੀਰੀਐ ॥
there is no other place for it; by no other means can the mind be steadied.
ਡਿਠਾ ਸਭੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ; ਸੁਖੁ ਨ. ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ॥
I have looked through the whole world: there is no happiness without the Lord's Name.
ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਹੋਸੀ ਛਾਰੁ; ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋਇ ਜਨੁ ॥
This body and wealth will come to dust, yet only a rare one understands this.
ਰੰਗ ਰੂਪ ਰਸ ਬਾਦਿ; ਕਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਪਰਾਣੀਆ ॥
Beauty, form and pleasures are all worthless; what are you doing, O creature?
ਜਿਸੁ ਭੁਲਾਏ ਆਪਿ; ਤਿਸੁ. ਕਲ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਣੀਆ ॥
One whom the Lord Himself leads astray never learns the worth of peace of mind.
Those dyed in the Lord's love sing of that everlasting Lord, who is free of desire.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਰਣਿ ਦੁਆਰਿ; ਜੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਹੀ ॥੨॥
O Nanak, say: Lord, those who are pleasing to You come to the shelter of Your door. ॥2॥
ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣੁ. ਨ ਤਿਨੑ ਕਉ; ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
Those who take the Lord as their support have no more round of birth and death.
ਜੀਵਤ ਸੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹੋਏ; ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨਿ ਜਾਗੇ ॥
They are accepted in this very life, for by praising the Lord they stay alert against vice.
Those alone are greatly fortunate who gain the company of such holy ones,
ਨਾਇ ਵਿਸਰਿਐ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣਾ; ਤੂਟੇ ਕਚ ਧਾਗੇ ॥
but if the Name is forgotten, life is accursed, as useless as a snapped thread of weak yarn.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਧੂੜਿ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਸਾਧ; ਲਖ ਕੋਟਿ ਪਿਰਾਗੇ ॥੧੬॥
O Nanak, the dust of the holy ones' feet is purer than hundreds of thousands and millions of Prayags. ॥16॥
ਧਰਣਿ ਸੁਵੰਨੀ, ਖੜ ਰਤਨ ਜੜਾਵੀ; ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪੁਰਖੁ, ਮਨਿ ਵੁਠਾ ॥
The mind in which the loving Lord comes to dwell is like grassy ground made lovely, studded with pearls of dew.
ਸਭੇ ਕਾਜ ਸੁਹੇਲੜੇ ਥੀਏ; ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਠਾ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, all the tasks of one with whom Guru Nanak, the true Guru, is pleased become easy. ॥1॥
ਫਿਰਦੀ ਫਿਰਦੀ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਾ; ਜਲ ਪਰਬਤ ਬਨਰਾਇ ॥
Flying on and on in all ten directions, over rivers, mountains and forests,
ਜਿਥੈ ਡਿਠਾ ਮਿਰਤਕੋ; ਇਲ ਬਹਿਠੀ ਆਇ ॥੨॥
the kite comes and settles wherever it sees a carcass. ॥2॥
ਜਿਸੁ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਫਲ ਲੋੜੀਅਹਿ; ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਉ ॥
May I remember that true Lord from whom all comforts and all fruits are asked.
ਨੇੜੈ ਦੇਖਉ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ; ਇਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਉ ॥
May I see the Supreme Lord close beside me and meditate on His Name alone.
ਹੋਇ ਸਗਲ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁਕਾ; ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਵਉ ॥
May I become the dust of everyone's feet and merge into the Lord.
ਦੂਖੁ. ਨ ਦੇਈ ਕਿਸੈ ਜੀਅ; ਪਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਵਉ ॥
May I cause pain to no being, and so go to my real home with honour.
ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ. ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ; ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਣਾਵਉ ॥੧੭॥
O Nanak, may I tell others too that the Creator purifies even the fallen. ॥17॥
ਏਕੁ ਜਿ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਮੈ ਕੀਆ; ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਸਮਰਥੁ ॥
I have made the One alone my friend, He who holds every power.
ਜੀਉ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਖੰਨੀਐ; ਹਰਿ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਸੰਦੜੀ ਵਥੁ ॥੧॥
The Lord is the real thing of use to mind and body; my soul is a sacrifice to Him. ॥1॥
ਜੇ ਕਰੁ ਗਹਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੜੇ; ਤੁਧੁ. ਨ ਛੋਡਾ ਮੂਲਿ ॥
Dearly Beloved, if You take my hand, I will never let go of You.
ਹਰਿ ਛੋਡਨਿ. ਸੇ ਦੁਰਜਨਾ; ਪੜਹਿ ਦੋਜਕ ਕੈ ਸੂਲਿ ॥੨॥
Those who forsake the Lord become evildoers and fall into the unbearable pain of hell. ॥2॥
ਸਭਿ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਘਰਿ ਜਿਸ ਦੈ; ਹਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
The Lord in whose house are all treasures: whatever He does is what happens.
ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਸੰਤ ਜਨ; ਪਾਪਾ ਮਲੁ ਧੋਵੈ ॥
His saints live by remembering Him again and again; He washes off the filth of their sins.
ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸਹਿ; ਸੰਕਟ ਸਭਿ ਖੋਵੈ ॥
His lotus feet dwell in their hearts; He destroys all their troubles.
ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਭੇਟੀਐ; ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਰੋਵੈ ॥
One who meets the perfect Guru neither falls into birth and death nor suffers.
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਰਸ ਪਿਆਸ ਨਾਨਕ ਘਣੀ; ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਵੈ ॥੧੮॥
Nanak too has a great thirst for the sight of God, but He gives it Himself, by His own grace. ॥18॥
ਭੋਰੀ ਭਰਮੁ ਵਞਾਇ ਪਿਰੀ; ਮੁਹਬਤਿ ਹਿਕੁ ਤੂ ॥
If you put aside even a little of the mind's wandering and love only the Beloved,
ਜਿਥਹੁ. ਵੰਞੈ ਜਾਇ; ਤਿਥਾਊ. ਮਉਜੂਦੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
then wherever you go, there you will see Him present. ॥1॥
ਚੜਿ ਕੈ ਘੋੜੜੈ, ਕੁੰਦੇ ਪਕੜਹਿ; ਖੂੰਡੀ ਦੀ ਖੇਡਾਰੀ ॥
Those who know only the game of stick and ball, yet mount fine horses and take hold of gun stocks,
ਹੰਸਾ ਸੇਤੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਉਲਾਸਹਿ; ਕੁਕੜ ਦੀ ਓਡਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
are like those who can fly only as a cock flies, yet set their hearts on flying with swans. ॥2॥
ਰਸਨਾ ਉਚਰੈ. ਹਰਿ ਸ੍ਰਵਣੀ ਸੁਣੈ; ਸੋ ਉਧਰੈ ਮਿਤਾ ॥
My friend, one who utters the Lord's Name with the tongue and hears it with the ears is saved.
ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਲਿਖਹਿ. ਲਾਇ ਭਾਵਨੀ; ਸੇ ਹਸਤ ਪਵਿਤਾ ॥
Pure are those hands of his that write the Lord's praise with faith.
ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਮਜਨਾ; ਸਭਿ ਪੁੰਨ ਤਿਨਿ ਕਿਤਾ ॥
He has, as it were, bathed at all sixty-eight pilgrim places and done every good deed.
ਸੰਸਾਰ ਸਾਗਰ ਤੇ ਉਧਰੇ; ਬਿਖਿਆ ਗੜੁ ਜਿਤਾ ॥
Such people are saved from the world-ocean; they have conquered the fortress of Maya.
323: ਨਾਨਕ. ਲੜਿ ਲਾਇ ਉਧਾਰਿਅਨੁ; ਦਯੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਅਮਿਤਾ ॥੧੯॥
O Nanak, remember that limitless Lord who has saved so many by joining them to Himself. ॥19॥
ਧੰਧੜੇ ਕੁਲਾਹ; ਚਿਤਿ. ਨ ਆਵੈ ਹੇਕੜੋ ॥
Those occupations are a loss in which the One does not come to mind,
ਨਾਨਕ. ਸੇਈ ਤੰਨ ਫੁਟੰਨਿ; ਜਿਨਾ ਸਾਂਈ ਵਿਸਰੈ ॥੧॥
for, O Nanak, the bodies of those who forget the Master are fouled by vice. ॥1॥
The Creator has made a god out of a ghost.
ਸਭੇ ਸਿਖ ਉਬਾਰਿਅਨੁ; ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
God Himself has set their affairs right and saved all the Sikhs.
He has seized the false slanderers and thrown them down in His court.
ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਵਡਾ ਹੈ; ਆਪਿ ਸਾਜਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
Nanak's God is the greatest; having created beings, He Himself sets them right. ॥2॥
ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ. ਕਿਛੁ ਅੰਤੁ ਨਾਹਿ; ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਕਰਣਾ ॥
God is without limit, no end to Him can be found; the whole world is His making.
ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੋ; ਜੀਆਂ ਕਾ ਪਰਣਾ ॥
That Master is unreachable, beyond the senses, and the support of all beings.
ਹਸਤ ਦੇਇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਦਾ; ਭਰਣ ਪੋਖਣੁ ਕਰਣਾ ॥
Giving His hand, He protects all and nourishes them.
ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨੁ ਬਖਸਿੰਦੁ ਆਪਿ; ਜਪਿ ਸਚੇ ਤਰਣਾ ॥
He is merciful and forgiving; by remembering the true One, beings cross over.
ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ. ਸੋ ਭਲਾ; ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਸਰਣਾ ॥੨੦॥
Servant Nanak, say: whatever happens by Your will is good; we are in Your shelter. ॥20॥
ਤਿੰਨਾ ਭੁਖ. ਨ ਕਾ ਰਹੀ; ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
Those whose protector is that Lord are left with no hunger at all.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਚਰਣੀ ਲਗਿਆ; ਉਧਰੈ ਸਭੋ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, everyone who clings to the Lord's feet is saved from the hunger for Maya. ॥1॥
ਜਾਚਿਕੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਨਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ; ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਕਰੇ ਕਬੂਲੁ ॥
The Master accepts the plea of the beggar who always asks for the Name.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਜਜਮਾਨੁ; ਤਿਸਹਿ. ਭੁਖ ਨ ਮੂਲਿ ॥੨॥
O Nanak, one whose patron is the Lord Himself has no hunger whatever. ॥2॥
ਮਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਸੰਗਿ; ਸਚੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਜੋੜੇ ॥
His mind is dyed in the Lord; the Lord's Name is his good food and clothing.
ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗੀ. ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਉ; ਏ ਹਸਤੀ ਘੋੜੇ ॥
Love for the Lord's Name has grown in him; this is his elephants and horses.
ਰਾਜ ਮਿਲਖ. ਖੁਸੀਆ ਘਣੀ; ਧਿਆਇ. ਮੁਖੁ ਨ ਮੋੜੇ ॥
He never tires of remembering the Lord; this is his kingdom, lands and countless joys.
ਢਾਢੀ ਦਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੰਗਣਾ; ਦਰੁ. ਕਦੇ ਨ ਛੋੜੇ ॥
That minstrel always begs at God's door and never leaves it.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਚਾਉ ਏਹੁ; ਨਿਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਲੋੜੇ ॥੨੧॥੧॥ ਸੁਧੁ ਕੀਚੇ
O Nanak, in his mind and body there is always this eagerness; he longs constantly to meet God. ॥21॥1॥ Sudh Keeche ॥
ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
One Creator, whose Name is Truth, the Maker — realised by the Guru's grace
ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ ਚਉਪਦੇ ੧੪ ॥
ਅਬ ਮੋਹਿ ਜਲਤ; ਰਾਮ ਜਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Burning as I was, I have now found the nectar of the Lord's Name,
ਰਾਮ ਉਦਕਿ; ਤਨੁ ਜਲਤ ਬੁਝਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
and that nectar has cooled my burning body. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
People go to the forests to subdue the mind,
ਸੋ ਜਲੁ; ਬਿਨੁ ਭਗਵੰਤ. ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੧॥
but the nectar that can calm it is not found without the Lord. ॥1॥
ਜਿਹ ਪਾਵਕ; ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਹੈ ਜਾਰੇ ॥
The fire that burned up gods and men,
from that burning the nectar of the Lord's Name has saved His devotees. ॥2॥
In this ocean of the world, now an ocean of comfort to them,
they go on drinking that nectar, and it never runs out. ॥3॥
the nectar of the Lord's Name has put out my thirst for Maya. ॥4॥1॥
ਮਾਧਉ; ਜਲ ਕੀ ਪਿਆਸ. ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
O Lord, my thirst for the nectar of Your Name does not go away.
ਜਲ ਮਹਿ; ਅਗਨਿ ਉਠੀ ਅਧਿਕਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The more I drink of it, the stronger the longing grows. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਤੂੰ ਜਲਨਿਧਿ; ਹਉ ਜਲ ਕਾ ਮੀਨੁ ॥
You are the ocean and I am a fish of that water.
ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਉ; ਜਲਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਖੀਨੁ ॥੧॥
Only in the water can I stay alive; without the water I die. ॥1॥
You are my cage and I am Your weak little parrot.
What harm can the cat, Death, do to me? ॥2॥
You are the fair tree and I am a bird that lives by it.
Unfortunate that I am, I have not yet had sight of You. ॥3॥
324: You are my Guru and I am Your new disciple.
ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਮਿਲੁ; ਅੰਤ ਕੀ ਬੇਲਾ ॥੪॥੨॥
Says Kabir: this is the final hour; do meet me now. ॥4॥2॥
ਜਬ ਹਮ; ਏਕੋ ਏਕੁ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
Since I came to understand that the One Lord alone pervades everywhere,
why have people taken it so badly? ॥1॥
I have lost all reserve and do not care whether anyone honours me or not.
ਹਮਰੈ ਖੋਜਿ; ਪਰਹੁ ਮਤਿ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Let no one follow after me on this path. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
If I am bad, I am bad within myself;
I keep up no dealings with anyone. ॥2॥
ਪਤਿ ਅਪਤਿ; ਤਾ ਕੀ ਨਹੀ ਲਾਜ ॥
Whether anyone honours or dishonours me, I see no shame in it,
for you will understand only when your own outward show is laid bare. ॥3॥
Says Kabir: real honour belongs to the one whom the Lord accepts.
Give up everything else and remember the Lord alone. ॥4॥3॥
If union with God could be had by going about naked,
ਬਨ ਕਾ ਮਿਰਗੁ; ਮੁਕਤਿ ਸਭੁ ਹੋਗੁ ॥੧॥
then every beast of the forest should be liberated. ॥1॥
What is gained by going naked, or by wrapping a skin about the body,
ਜਬ ਨਹੀ ਚੀਨਸਿ; ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
so long as you do not recognise the Lord? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
If spiritual attainment came from shaving the head,
why has no sheep ever been liberated? ॥2॥
If one could cross over, brother, by remaining celibate,
ਖੁਸਰੈ ਕਿਉ ਨ; ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੩॥
why does a eunuch not attain liberation? ॥3॥
ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ; ਕਿਨਿ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥੪॥
no one has found liberation without remembering the Lord's Name. ॥4॥4॥
Those who merely bathe morning and evening
are like frogs living in the water. ॥1॥
ਜਉ ਪੈ; ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
If there is no love for the Lord's Name in their hearts,
ਤੇ ਸਭਿ; ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਕੈ ਜਾਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
they all fall into the power of Dharamraj. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Out of attachment to the body, some put on many religious garbs;
ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਦਇਆ; ਸੁਪਨੈ ਭੀ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
compassion has never come to them, even in a dream. ॥2॥
Many clever people merely recite the four Vedas.
In this ocean of the world only the saints enjoy real happiness. ॥3॥
Says Kabir: the sum of all reflection is this,
give up attachment to all things and drink in the taste of the Lord's Name. ॥4॥5॥
ਕਿਆ ਜਪੁ. ਕਿਆ ਤਪੁ; ਕਿਆ ਬ੍ਰਤ ਪੂਜਾ ॥
What use is his chanting, his austerity, his fasting and worship,
ਜਾ ਕੈ ਰਿਦੈ; ਭਾਉ ਹੈ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੧॥
in whose heart there is love for another than God? ॥1॥
ਰੇ ਜਨ; ਮਨੁ ਮਾਧਉ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
O brother, the mind should be joined to the Lord.
God is not found through cleverness. ॥ Rahao ॥
Give up greed and outward show.
Give up lust, anger and pride. ॥2॥
Performing religious rites, people are bound in pride,
and together they worship mere stones. ॥3॥
Says Kabir: the Lord is found only by devotion,
He is met through a guileless nature. ॥4॥6॥
ਗਰਭ ਵਾਸ ਮਹਿ; ਕੁਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਤੀ ॥
In the mother's womb no one knows what family he belongs to.
All beings arise from a portion of God Himself. ॥1॥
ਕਹੁ ਰੇ ਪੰਡਿਤ; ਬਾਮਨ ਕਬ ਕੇ ਹੋਏ ॥
Tell me, O Pandit, since when have you been a Brahmin?
ਬਾਮਨ ਕਹਿ ਕਹਿ; ਜਨਮੁ ਮਤ ਖੋਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Do not waste your human life saying again and again, I am a Brahmin. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
If you are truly a Brahmin, born of a Brahmin woman,
ਤਉ ਆਨ ਬਾਟ; ਕਾਹੇ ਨਹੀ ਆਇਆ ॥੨॥
why were you not born by some other way? ॥2॥
ਤੁਮ ਕਤ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣ; ਹਮ ਕਤ ਸੂਦ ॥
How are you Brahmins, and how are we Shudras?
ਹਮ ਕਤ ਲੋਹੂ; ਤੁਮ ਕਤ ਦੂਧ ॥੩॥
How is there blood in us, and milk in you? ॥3॥
Says Kabir: one who remembers God,
that is the one we call a Brahmin. ॥4॥7॥
325: ਅੰਧਕਾਰ; ਸੁਖਿ ਕਬਹਿ ਨ ਸੋਈ ਹੈ ॥
In the darkness of ignorance no one ever sleeps in peace;
ਰਾਜਾ ਰੰਕੁ ਦੋਊ; ਮਿਲਿ ਰੋਈ ਹੈ ॥੧॥
king or pauper, both alike suffer. ॥1॥
ਜਉ ਪੈ; ਰਸਨਾ ਰਾਮੁ. ਨ ਕਹਿਬੋ ॥
As long as you do not repeat the Lord with your tongue,
you go on being born, dying and weeping. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Maya is like the shade of a tree as we see it, never staying put;
ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਗਏ; ਕਹੁ ਕਾ ਕੀ ਮਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
when the breath departs, tell me, whose is this Maya then? ॥2॥
As the sound of the music sinks back into the instrument,
ਮੂਏ ਮਰਮੁ; ਕੋ ਕਾ ਕਰ ਜਾਨਾ ॥੩॥
so how can anyone know the secret of the dead, where the life has gone? ॥3॥
As the lake is to the swans, so is death to bodies, always hovering near;
so drink, O Kabir, the nectar of the Name, the best of all tastes. ॥4॥8॥
ਜੋਤਿ ਕੀ ਜਾਤਿ; ਜਾਤਿ ਕੀ ਜੋਤੀ ॥
The whole creation is God's making, and the understanding of the beings in that creation
bears fruits of glass and of pearl (some turn to good, some to evil). ॥1॥
ਕਵਨੁ ਸੁ ਘਰੁ; ਜੋ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
Which is that place that is free of fear,
ਭਉ ਭਜਿ ਜਾਇ; ਅਭੈ ਹੋਇ ਰਹੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
where fear runs off and one can live unafraid? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
On a holy riverbank or at a place of pilgrimage the mind does not settle;
there too people are tangled in merit and sin. ॥2॥
Sin and merit are both the same;
ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਪਾਰਸੁ; ਤਜਹੁ ਗੁਨ ਆਨ ॥੩॥
the philosopher's stone is within your own self, so give up taking on other qualities. ॥3॥
O Kabir, do not forget the Name of the Lord who is above Maya;
set your mind to the work of repeating the Name and stay occupied in it. ॥4॥9॥
Those who only say they have known the Lord who has no limit and lies beyond the mind's reach
have reached heaven by talk alone. ॥1॥
I for one do not know where that heaven is,
ਜਾਨੁ ਜਾਨੁ; ਸਭਿ ਕਹਹਿ ਤਹਾ ਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
the place of which everybody says, we must go there, we must go there. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Merely saying it and hearing it said does not satisfy the mind;
ਤਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੈ; ਜਾ ਤੇ. ਹਉਮੈ ਜਈ ਹੈ ॥੨॥
the mind finds rest only when pride is gone. ॥2॥
ਜਬ ਲਗੁ; ਮਨਿ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ਕੀ ਆਸ ॥
As long as the mind holds a longing for heaven,
ਤਬ ਲਗੁ; ਹੋਇ ਨਹੀ. ਚਰਨ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥੩॥
it cannot be joined to the Lord's feet. ॥3॥
Says Kabir: how is this to be made plain to anyone,
that the company of the holy is itself the real heaven? ॥4॥10॥
A being is conceived, comes into existence, and having come into existence perishes;
before our very eyes this world is passing away. ॥1॥
ਲਾਜ ਨ ਮਰਹੁ; ਕਹਹੁ ਘਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
Why do you not die of shame when you say, this house is mine?
ਅੰਤ ਕੀ ਬਾਰ; ਨਹੀ ਕਛੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
When the end comes, nothing at all is yours. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
With countless efforts this body is nurtured,
yet when death comes it is burnt in the fire. ॥2॥
The body whose limbs are rubbed with perfume and sandalwood,
ਸੋ ਤਨੁ ਜਲੈ; ਕਾਠ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਾ ॥੩॥
that body burns along with the firewood. ॥3॥
Says Kabir: listen, thoughtful man, and remember,
this form will perish while the whole world looks on. ॥4॥11॥
What use is it to grieve when others die?
Grieve only if you yourself were to go on living here. ॥1॥
My soul never dies; the dead are those caught up in the world's affairs.
ਅਬ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਹੈ; ਜੀਆਵਨਹਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
I have now met the Lord, the giver of real life. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
A person scents this body with many fragrances,
and in those very comforts forgets the Lord, who is supreme bliss. ॥2॥
The body is a little well and the five senses are its five pulleys;
the ruined intellect goes on drawing water without a rope. ॥3॥
Says Kabir: when an understanding that reflects awoke within,
then neither that attachment to the body remained nor those senses that pull towards vice. ॥4॥12॥
As things that stand still and things that move, as worms and moths,
we have already passed through births of many kinds. ॥1॥
326: We have passed through many such bodies,
ਜਬ ਹਮ ਰਾਮ; ਗਰਭ ਹੋਇ ਆਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
O Lord, as we kept falling into one birth after another. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
At times we were yogis, celibates, ascetics, students of chastity;
at times kings under the royal canopy, at times beggars. ॥2॥
Those cut off from God keep falling into birth after birth, while the saints all live,
for with the tongue they drink the supreme nectar of the Lord's Name. ॥3॥
Says Kabir: O God, show mercy;
worn out, we have fallen at Your door, so now grant us Your knowledge. ॥4॥13॥
ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ਕੀ ਨਾਲਿ ਰਲਾਇ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
O Kabir, I have seen a strange spectacle:
ਦਧਿ ਕੈ ਭੋਲੈ; ਬਿਰੋਲੈ ਨੀਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
mistaking it for curd, a person is churning water. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The foolish being, like a donkey on green shoots, feeds on the vices his mind fancies;
always laughing and braying, he ends up in the round of birth and death. ॥1॥
The mind, like a bull drunk with heat, runs unruly;
it leaps about, grazes on the crop of sense-pleasures and falls into hell. ॥2॥
Says Kabir: this strange spectacle has become clear to me,
the ewe is forever sucking at her lamb: the intellect of worldly people trails after the mind. ॥3॥
Through remembering the Lord my intellect has awakened;
says Kabir: it is the Guru who has given this understanding. ॥4॥1॥14॥
ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਛੋਡਿ; ਬਾਹਰਿ ਭਇਓ ਮੀਨਾ ॥
(People tell me:) as a fish leaves the water and comes out to die,
ਪੂਰਬ ਜਨਮ; ਹਉ ਤਪ ਕਾ ਹੀਨਾ ॥੧॥
so I too must have done no penance in past births. ॥1॥
ਅਬ ਕਹੁ ਰਾਮ; ਕਵਨ ਗਤਿ ਮੋਰੀ ॥
Tell me now, O Lord, what will become of me?
ਤਜੀ ਲੇ ਬਨਾਰਸ; ਮਤਿ ਭਈ ਥੋਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
I have left Benares; is it true that my sense has failed me? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
(They say:) you wasted your whole life in Shiva's city,
for at the hour of death you got up and came to Magahar. ॥2॥
(They say:) for many years you practised penance in Kashi,
and when the time to die arrived you settled in Magahar. ॥3॥
(They taunt:) you have taken Kashi and Magahar to be the same;
with such shallow devotion how will you cross over? ॥4॥
ਕਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਗਜ ਸਿਵ; ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
Say: everyone recognises only Ganesh and Shiva,
but Kabir, by remembering the Lord, has done away with his very self. ॥5॥15॥
The body whose limbs are rubbed with perfume and sandalwood,
ਸੋ ਤਨੁ ਜਲੈ; ਕਾਠ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਾ ॥੧॥
that body is laid in firewood and burnt. ॥1॥
ਇਸੁ ਤਨ ਧਨ ਕੀ; ਕਵਨ ਬਡਾਈ ॥
What is there to be proud of in this body and wealth?
ਧਰਨਿ ਪਰੈ; ਉਰਵਾਰਿ. ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
They are left lying on the ground here and do not go along. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਰਾਤਿ ਜਿ ਸੋਵਹਿ; ਦਿਨ ਕਰਹਿ ਕਾਮ ॥
Those who sleep through the night and work at worldly tasks by day,
ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ; ਲੇਹਿ ਨ. ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮ ॥੨॥
but do not repeat the Lord's Name for even a moment; ॥2॥
ਹਾਥਿ ਤ ਡੋਰ; ਮੁਖਿ ਖਾਇਓ ਤੰਬੋਰ ॥
those who chew betel in the mouth and hold a hawk's string in the hand,
are tied up tight like thieves at the hour of death. ॥3॥
ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਸਿ ਰਸਿ; ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
One who takes the Guru's teaching and sings the Lord's praises with great love
finds peace by remembering the Lord and the Lord alone. ॥4॥
The one in whose heart the Lord, in His mercy, plants His Name,
in him He settles the fragrance of the Name. ॥5॥
Says Kabir: O ignorant one, remember the Lord.
The Lord alone lasts for ever; every other entanglement is perishable. ॥6॥16॥
ਜਮ ਤੇ ਉਲਟਿ; ਭਏ ਹੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
Those who looked to me like messengers of Death have turned into the Lord's own form;
my sorrows are gone and comforts have made their home in me.
Those who were enemies have turned into friends;
once cut off from God, they have turned and become godly at heart. ॥1॥
ਅਬ ਮੋਹਿ; ਸਰਬ ਕੁਸਲ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
Now everything feels like comfort and joy to me;
ਸਾਂਤਿ ਭਈ; ਜਬ ਗੋਬਿਦੁ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
a coolness has settled within since I came to know the Lord. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
327: In my body there were millions of troubles;
through staying joined to the Name in poise they have all turned into comforts.
My mind has recognised its own true self and now sees only the Lord;
sickness and the three fevers can no longer touch it. ॥2॥
Now my mind has turned from its old nature and become the Lord's own form;
I understood this when the mind, though living amid Maya, rose above attachment to it.
Says Kabir: I stay absorbed in spiritual joy, in a state of poise;
ਆਪਿ ਨ ਡਰਉ; ਨ ਅਵਰ ਡਰਾਵਉ ॥੩॥੧੭॥
I neither fear anyone nor make others afraid. ॥3॥17॥
ਪਿੰਡਿ ਮੂਐ; ਜੀਉ. ਕਿਹ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
When attachment to the body dies, where does the soul come to rest?
Through the Guru's Word it stays joined to the Lord who is beyond Maya's bonds and without end.
Only the one who has known the Lord within has recognised Him,
as a mute man's mind is content with sugar and cannot explain the taste. ॥1॥
Such knowledge the Lord Himself reveals;
ਮਨ ਰੇ ਪਵਨ ਦ੍ਰਿੜ; ਸੁਖਮਨ ਨਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
so, O mind, repeat the Name with every breath: this is the practice of the sukhmana channel. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਹੁ; ਜਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ. ਨ ਕਰਨਾ ॥
Take such a Guru that you never need take another;
ਸੋ ਪਦੁ ਰਵਹੁ; ਜਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ. ਨ ਰਵਨਾ ॥
enjoy such a state that no craving for any other taste is left.
ਸੋ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਧਰਹੁ; ਜਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ. ਨ ਧਰਨਾ ॥
Fix your attention in such a way that it never needs fixing elsewhere;
ਐਸੇ ਮਰਹੁ; ਜਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ. ਨ ਮਰਨਾ ॥੨॥
die in such a way, rid of self, that you need not fall into death again. ॥2॥
I have turned my mind's bent around and so I join the Ganges with the Yamuna;
ਬਿਨੁ ਜਲ ਸੰਗਮ; ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਨੑਾਵਉ ॥
I bathe at that confluence within the mind where there is no water.
With these eyes I look on all alike; this is how I deal with the world.
Having remembered the one Lord, what other reflection do I need? ॥3॥
Like water, fire, air, earth and sky, I have taken on their good qualities;
joined to the Lord's feet, this is the way I live.
Says Kabir: I remember the Lord who is free of Maya,
ਤਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਉ; ਜਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ. ਨ ਆਵਉ ॥੪॥੧੮॥
and have reached that home from which there is no coming back. ॥4॥18॥
God is not obtained by weighing out gold in exchange;
ਮਨੁ ਦੇ; ਰਾਮੁ ਲੀਆ ਹੈ ਮੋਲਿ ॥੧॥
I have found Him by giving my mind as the price. ॥1॥
ਅਬ ਮੋਹਿ; ਰਾਮੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
Now I am convinced that God is my very own;
ਸਹਜ ਸੁਭਾਇ; ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
of its own accord this knot has been tied in my mind. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਬ੍ਰਹਮੈ ਕਥਿ ਕਥਿ; ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
The God whose end Brahma could not find for all his telling of His qualities,
that God, because of my devotion, has come without effort to meet me in my own heart. ॥2॥
Says Kabir: I have given up my fickle nature;
devotion to God alone has fallen to my share. ॥3॥1॥19॥
The death that has frightened the whole world,
through the Guru's Word I have come to see what that death really is. ॥1॥
ਅਬ ਕੈਸੇ ਮਰਉ; ਮਰਨਿ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
Why would I now fall into birth and death? My mind is reconciled to the death of self.
ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਤੇ; ਜਿਨ. ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Only those who have not known the Lord keep dying again and again. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Everyone keeps saying, death, death, in dread of it;
but one who, abiding in poise, dies to worldly desires becomes immortal. ॥2॥
Says Kabir: joy has arisen in my mind;
my delusion is gone and the highest bliss has stayed. ॥3॥20॥
ਕਤ ਨਹੀ ਠਉਰ; ਮੂਲੁ ਕਤ ਲਾਵਉ ॥
There is no such spot anywhere, so where am I to apply the medicine?
ਖੋਜਤ ਤਨ ਮਹਿ; ਠਉਰ. ਨ ਪਾਵਉ ॥੧॥
Searching through the body, I find no place where this pain of separation can be pointed out. ॥1॥
Only the one who is struck knows what this pain is like;
devotion to the Lord is a sharp-pointed arrow. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
I see all the soul-brides as in love with the one Lord,
but how am I to know which of them is dear to the Husband? ॥2॥
ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ; ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ॥
Says Kabir: the one on whose forehead good fortune is written,
ਸਭ ਪਰਹਰਿ; ਤਾ ਕਉ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਹਾਗੁ ॥੩॥੨੧॥
the Husband passes over all the others and comes to meet her. ॥3॥21॥
328: ਜਾ ਕੈ; ਹਰਿ ਸਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ. ਭਾਈ ॥
O friend, the one in whose heart the Lord Himself dwells as Master,
to him liberation offers itself over and over. ॥1॥
Say now: O Lord, one who relies on You alone
ਤਬ ਕਾਹੂ ਕਾ; ਕਵਨੁ ਨਿਹੋਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
has no need to flatter anyone. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਤੀਨਿ ਲੋਕ; ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਹਿ ਭਾਰ ॥
He on whose support the three worlds rest,
why would He not look after you? ॥2॥
Says Kabir: I have thought one thing through;
ਕਿਆ ਬਸੁ; ਜਉ. ਬਿਖੁ ਦੇ ਮਹਤਾਰੀ ॥੩॥੨੨॥
what can a child do if the mother herself gives the poison? ॥3॥22॥
ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤ; ਸਤੀ ਹੋਇ ਕੈਸੇ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
Without fidelity, how can a woman be a sati?
O pandit, reflect in your mind and see. ॥1॥
In the same way, without love in the heart how can a bond with the Husband-Lord be formed?
ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਰਸੁ; ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਨਹੀ ਨੇਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
As long as the taste for Maya remains, there can be no love for Him. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
One who in his heart holds Maya alone to be real
ਸੋ ਰਮਯੇ ਕਉ; ਮਿਲੈ ਨ. ਸੁਪਨੈ ॥੨॥
does not meet the Lord even in a dream. ॥2॥
ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਧਨੁ; ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਸਉਪਿ ਸਰੀਰੁ ॥
She who hands over body, mind, wealth, home and self to her Husband,
she alone is the fortunate bride, says Kabir. ॥3॥23॥
The whole world is held down by Maya;
Maya has drowned the entire family of living beings. ॥1॥
ਰੇ ਨਰ; ਨਾਵ ਚਉੜਿ ਕਤ ਬੋੜੀ ॥
O man, why have you sunk your boat on bare open ground?
ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਤੋੜਿ; ਬਿਖਿਆ ਸੰਗਿ ਜੋੜੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
You have broken with the Lord and tied yourself to Maya. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The fire of craving is alight and gods and men are burning in it;
ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨੀਰੁ; ਪਸੁ. ਪੀਵਸਿ ਨ ਝਾਗਿ ॥੨॥
the water is close by, yet this animal makes no effort to drink it. ॥2॥
That water wells up in the heart only through constant remembrance;
that water is pure, says Kabir. ॥3॥24॥
ਜਿਹ ਕੁਲਿ ਪੂਤੁ; ਨ ਗਿਆਨ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
The family in which no son is born who reflects on spiritual knowledge,
why did his mother not become a widow instead? ॥1॥
ਜਿਹ ਨਰ; ਰਾਮ ਭਗਤਿ. ਨਹਿ ਸਾਧੀ ॥
The man who has not practised devotion to the Lord,
ਜਨਮਤ; ਕਸ. ਨ ਮੁਓ, ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
why did that offender not die at birth? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਮੁਚੁ ਮੁਚੁ ਗਰਭ ਗਏ; ਕੀਨ ਬਚਿਆ ॥
So many pregnancies miscarry; why was this one spared?
Bare of devotion, he lives in the world like a leper. ॥2॥
Says Kabir: those without the Name may be handsome to look at,
but lacking the Name they are in truth hunchbacked and ugly. ॥3॥25॥
ਜੋ ਜਨ ਲੇਹਿ; ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
Those who repeat the Name of the Lord, the Master,
to them I am for ever devoted. ॥1॥
ਸੋ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ; ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
The brother who sings the Lord's pure praises is himself pure,
ਸੋ ਭਾਈ; ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
and he is dear to my mind. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Those in whose hearts the Lord has become manifest,
ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਪਗ ਪੰਕਜ; ਹਮ ਧੂਰਿ ॥੨॥
I am the dust of their lotus feet. ॥2॥
Kabir is a weaver by caste, yet steady of mind,
for, abiding in poise, Kabir sings the Lord's qualities. ॥3॥26॥
From the still of my inner sky a sweet nectar drips;
ਸੰਚਿ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ; ਤਨੁ ਭਇਆ ਕਾਠੀ ॥੧॥
as I gather this great nectar of the Name, attachment to the body serves as the firewood. ॥1॥
That person is called naturally intoxicated
ਪੀਵਤ ਰਾਮ ਰਸੁ; ਗਿਆਨ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
who has drunk the Lord's nectar through reflection on spiritual knowledge. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
When the wine-seller that is the state of poise comes and meets one,
then each day passes drunk with joy. ॥2॥
When, savouring that joy, I fixed my mind on the Formless Lord,
says Kabir: then I found the light within. ॥3॥27॥
The inner bent of the mind holds sway over the whole of the mind's activity,
329: so what success is gained by killing the mind? ॥1॥
ਕਵਨੁ ਸੁ ਮੁਨਿ; ਜੋ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰੈ ॥
Who is that sage who kills the mind?
ਮਨ ਕਉ ਮਾਰਿ; ਕਹਹੁ ਕਿਸੁ ਤਾਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Tell me, having killed the mind, whom does he carry across? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Everyone speaks as the mind prompts,
ਮਨ ਮਾਰੇ ਬਿਨੁ; ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੨॥
so without killing the mind (turning it from vice) there is no devotion either. ॥2॥
Says Kabir: the one who understands this secret,
his mind becomes the very form of God, who lights the three worlds. ॥3॥28॥
Those stars that are seen in the sky,
ਕਹੁ ਰੇ ਪੰਡਿਤ; ਅੰਬਰੁ ਕਾ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
Tell me, O pandit, what holds the sky up?
Only some fortunate, discerning person understands this. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The sun and moon that give out light,
in all of them it is the radiance of God's own light that is spread. ॥2॥
Says Kabir: only that person will understand this
in whose heart the Lord dwells and in whose mouth is the Lord alone. ॥3॥29॥
O brother, this Simriti, built upon the Vedas,
has come bringing chains (of caste and stage of life) and ropes (of ritual). ॥1॥
It has itself bound fast all its own followers;
ਮੋਹ ਕੈ ਫਾਧਿ; ਕਾਲ ਸਰੁ ਸਾਂਧਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
trapping them in the noose of attachment, it has drawn the arrow of death over them. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਕਟੀ ਨ ਕਟੈ; ਤੂਟਿ ਨਹ ਜਾਈ ॥
This noose cannot be cut by cutting, nor does it snap of itself;
ਸਾ ਸਾਪਨਿ ਹੋਇ; ਜਗ ਕਉ ਖਾਈ ॥੨॥
it has turned into a she-serpent and is devouring the world. ॥2॥
ਹਮ ਦੇਖਤ; ਜਿਨਿ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਲੂਟਿਆ ॥
This Simriti which, before our eyes, has robbed the whole world,
ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ; ਮੈ ਰਾਮ ਕਹਿ ਛੂਟਿਆ ॥੩॥੩੦॥
says Kabir: I have escaped it by remembering the Lord. ॥3॥30॥
I put the headstall on my mind and fit it with the bridle of love,
and saddling it with the knowledge that God is everywhere, I set it racing to the land of the Formless One. ॥1॥
Let us mount the horse of reflection on our own true nature,
ਸਹਜ ਕੈ ਪਾਵੜੈ; ਪਗੁ ਧਰਿ ਲੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
and keep the foot of our understanding in the stirrup of poise. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਚਲੁ ਰੇ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ; ਤੁਝਹਿ ਲੇ ਤਾਰਉ ॥
Come, O mind, let me take you on a ride through heaven;
ਹਿਚਹਿ ਤ; ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕੈ ਚਾਬੁਕ ਮਾਰਉ ॥੨॥
if you baulk, I will strike you with the whip of love. ॥2॥
Says Kabir: wise riders such as these
stay clear of the quarrel over the Vedas and the Semitic books. ॥3॥31॥
The mouth with which all five choice foods are eaten,
to that mouth, at death, a burning brand is put before one's eyes. ॥1॥
ਇਕੁ ਦੁਖੁ; ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ਕਾਟਹੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
O my beautiful Lord, remove this one suffering of mine,
ਅਗਨਿ ਦਹੈ; ਅਰੁ ਗਰਭ ਬਸੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
the burning in the fire of craving and the dwelling in the womb. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
After death this body is ruined in many ways;
ਕੋ ਜਾਰੇ; ਕੋ ਗਡਿ ਲੇ ਮਾਟੀ ॥੨॥
one burns it, another buries it in the earth. ॥2॥
Says Kabir: O Lord, grant me the sight of Your feet;
ਪਾਛੈ ਤੇ ਜਮੁ; ਕਿਉ ਨ ਪਠਾਵਹੁ ॥੩॥੩੨॥
after that, by all means send Death to me. ॥3॥32॥
The Master is Himself the fire and Himself the wind;
if He Himself sets about burning someone, who can save him? ॥1॥
ਰਾਮ ਜਪਤ; ਤਨੁ ਜਰਿ ਕੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Though his body burn as he remembers the Lord, he does not care,
ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ; ਚਿਤੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
he whose mind stays joined to the Lord's Name. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਕਾ ਕੋ ਜਰੈ; ਕਾਹਿ ਹੋਇ ਹਾਨਿ ॥
For nothing of anyone's is burnt and no one suffers any loss;
the Lord Himself is at play everywhere, like an acrobat in his many guises. ॥2॥
Says Kabir: keep this one small thing in mind,
if it pleases the Master, He Himself will save you. ॥3॥33॥
ਨਾ ਮੈ; ਜੋਗ ਧਿਆਨ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
I have paid no heed to the meditation that yoga teaches,
for without detachment there is no release from Maya. ॥1॥
We cannot live a true life at all,
330: ਜਬ ਨ ਹੋਇ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
if we do not have the support of the Lord's Name. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Says Kabir: I have searched as far as the sky,
and have found no other to match the Lord. ॥2॥34॥
ਜਿਹ ਸਿਰਿ; ਰਚਿ ਰਚਿ ਬਾਧਤ ਪਾਗ ॥
The head on which a man so carefully arranges his turban,
that head the crows will dress with their beaks. ॥1॥
ਇਸੁ ਤਨ ਧਨ ਕੋ; ਕਿਆ ਗਰਬਈਆ ॥
Why take pride in this body and this wealth?
ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ; ਕਾਹੇ ਨ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੑੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Why do you not remember the Lord's Name? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Says Kabir: listen, O my mind,
the same will happen to you as well. ॥2॥35॥
ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ਕੀ ॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
The comfort that brings suffering when it is asked for,
ਸੋ ਸੁਖੁ; ਹਮਹੁ. ਨ ਮਾਂਗਿਆ ਭਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
that comfort I have no need to ask for. ॥1॥
Our awareness is still fixed on Maya, and from it we hope for comfort;
ਕੈਸੇ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ; ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ਨਿਵਾਸਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
how then can the Lord, the King who is all light, come to dwell in it? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਇਸੁ ਸੁਖ ਤੇ; ਸਿਵ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਡਰਾਨਾ ॥
Even Shiva and Brahma shrank back from this comfort of Maya,
ਸੋ ਸੁਖੁ; ਹਮਹੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨਾ ॥੨॥
yet we worldly people have taken this comfort to be real. ॥2॥
Sanak and his brothers, the sage Narad and Sheshnag,
ਤਿਨ ਭੀ ਤਨ ਮਹਿ; ਮਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਪੇਖਾ ॥੩॥
even they could not see the mind settled within their own body. ॥3॥
ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਉ; ਕੋਈ ਖੋਜਹੁ ਭਾਈ ॥
Let someone search into this mind, brother:
when it parts from the body, where does the mind go to rest? ॥4॥
By the Guru's grace, only devotees such as Jaidev and Namdev
ਭਗਤਿ ਕੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ; ਇਨ ਹੀ ਹੈ ਜਾਨਾਂ ॥੫॥
have understood this, through their joy in devotion. ॥5॥
ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਉ; ਨਹੀ ਆਵਨ ਜਾਨਾ ॥
This soul does not have to pass through birth and death
ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਭਰਮੁ ਗਇਆ; ਤਿਨਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਛਾਨਾ ॥੬॥
in one whose wandering has ended and who has recognised the Lord. ॥6॥
ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਉ; ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖਿਆ ਕਾਈ ॥
This soul has no form or mark of its own apart from the Lord.
By His command it came to be, and by understanding His will it merges in Him. ॥7॥
ਇਸ ਮਨ ਕਾ; ਕੋਈ ਜਾਨੈ ਭੇਉ ॥
Whoever comes to know the secret of this mind
merges within through this very mind and becomes one with the Lord, giver of peace. ॥8॥
He who is Himself one and is present in all bodies,
ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਉ; ਰਵਿ ਰਹੇ ਕਬੀਰਾ ॥੯॥੧॥੩੬॥
on that all-pervading Mind, the Lord, Kabir dwells in remembrance. ॥9॥1॥36॥
Those who stay awake day and night in the one Name,
ਕੇਤਕ ਸਿਧ ਭਏ; ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
many of them have reached the goal, their attention held on it. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Strivers, adepts and all the sages have worn themselves out;
the Name alone is the wish-fulfilling tree that carries one across. ॥1॥
ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ; ਸੁ ਹੋਹਿ ਨ. ਆਨਾ ॥
Those who remember the Lord do not remain separate from Him;
Says Kabir: they have come to know the Lord's Name closely. ॥2॥37॥
ਰੇ ਜੀਅ ਨਿਲਜ; ਲਾਜ ਤੋੁਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
O shameless mind, do you feel no shame?
ਹਰਿ ਤਜਿ; ਕਤ ਕਾਹੂ ਕੇ ਜਾਂਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Leaving the Lord, where and to whom do you go? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸੋ ਜਨੁ; ਪਰ ਘਰ ਜਾਤ. ਨ ਸੋਹੀ ॥੧॥
does not look well going to other people's houses. ॥1॥
That Master is present in every place,
always with you, never far away. ॥2॥
ਕਵਲਾ; ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨ ਹੈ ਜਾ ਕੇ ॥
He at whose feet even Lakshmi takes shelter,
ਕਹੁ ਜਨ; ਕਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਘਰ ਤਾ ਕੇ ॥੩॥
tell me, friend, what is lacking in His house? ॥3॥
ਸਭੁ ਕੋਊ ਕਹੈ; ਜਾਸੁ ਕੀ ਬਾਤਾ ॥
He of whose greatness everyone speaks
ਸੋ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਥੁ; ਨਿਜ ਪਤਿ ਹੈ ਦਾਤਾ ॥੪॥
is all-powerful, our own Master and the giver of everything. ॥4॥
Says Kabir: in this world only that person is truly worthy
ਜਾ ਕੇ ਹਿਰਦੈ; ਅਵਰੁ. ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੫॥੩੮॥
in whose heart there is no other but the Lord. ॥5॥38॥
